subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should configured model-cost estimates remain USD-only, or should OpenClaw define a supported non-USD currency contract for local pricing and cost display?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing provider-level, model-level, or global currency semantics affects public config, status output, Control UI aggregation, telemetry names, docs, and provider-reported billing boundaries.

options.title: Design one currency contract first
options.body: Choose scope, validation, mixed-currency aggregation, persisted-field semantics, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Keep configured estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave models.providers.*.models[].cost as USD estimates and direct non-USD billing visibility to provider-reported usage surfaces.

options.title: Allow display-only override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol override while explicitly documenting that stored totals, telemetry, and aggregation remain local estimates rather than converted invoices.

recommendation.title: Design one currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose scope, validation, mixed-currency aggregation, persisted-field semantics, and docs before implementation.
